name: Clear Transcodes
description: Adds a maintenance task that deletes files from the transcode temp directory once they are older than a configurable number of hours, so abandoned transcodes stop filling up the disk.
overview: Keeps the transcode temp folder from filling up.

versions.changelog: Initial release: scheduled task that deletes transcode temp files older than a configurable age (default 24h) and cleans up the folders they leave behind.
